baseline_matching.interpretation: Matching established only if all six interval gates and calibration gate pass; no refitting or sample extension.

bootstrap_method: Whole-seed multinomial multiplicities, common across all condition arms; pooled rates are ratios of summed counts/exposure.

control_window_diagnostic.interpretation: Finite-window diagnostic; nonsignificance does not establish stationarity.

stationary_bridge_prediction.scope: Fixed stationary q2 benchmark; full ICU bridges and policy transients need not satisfy its assumptions.

two_bank_diagnostics.method: Independent whole-seed resampling within A and B; synchronized condition weights within each bank. Primary estimates pool both banks regardless of disagreement.

uncertainty_scope: Fresh holdout intervals conditional on locked p; calibration selection/interpolation uncertainty and clinical-input uncertainty excluded.
